searchText: Add eth_blobBaseFee; add blobs to eth_fe... Is it relevant for someone to encode arbitrary data as blobs? Is it obvious how to do it efficiently using every bit? Just wanted to spend some time on potential encoder, and confirming it might be useful/no bicycle reinvented I have two encoders somewhere, a packed one and a non-packed one. Found here https://github.com/MariusVanDerWijden/blob-me-baby/blob/master/encode.go#L79 I feel deja vu coding this.
